## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List commands actually run, results and skipped checks. Preserve existing behavior
assertions. For UI changes, include an actual Electron journey and before/after captures.
For persistence changes, include refusal, retry and restart evidence using the native owner.

## Boundaries and risks

Describe changed ownership, permissions, dependencies or network behavior. Note any API
runtime/archive coordination. Source acceptance does not imply a deployment or live
provider test. No credentials or private Garden data should appear in this PR.
